{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive bias (e.g., >0.50) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after sharp spikes.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast downward.",
    "Cap upward forecasts at 10% above recent 7-day average if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "If sentiment history includes multiple 0.00 entries followed by a spike, reduce forecast peak by 15-20% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3+ consecutive days), apply a downward bias correction of 3-5% per day.",
    "For sentiment history with 0.00 entries, assume low volatility; avoid large swings in forecast unless confirmed by new data."
  ]
}
